name: algermusicplayer-ios-build
description: iOS build scaffold for AlgerMusicPlayer - reuses the official Android web assets (already bundle-injected with the cloud music API at mc.alger.fun) and builds an unsigned IPA via Capacitor on GitHub Actions macOS runners.
_notes: @jofr/capacitor-media-session 4.0.0 declares peer @capacitor/core ^6.0.0 (no 7.x exists); npm only warns. If pod install fails on iOS, pin Capacitor to 6.x and drop safe-area, or replace media-session.
